response.sql: WITH matched AS (SELECT o.recordvault, o.dealedge FROM riskandmargin rm INNER JOIN orders o ON rm.ordervault = o.recordvault), side_counts AS (SELECT dealedge, COUNT(DISTINCT recordvault) as order_count FROM matched GROUP BY dealedge), avg_calc AS (SELECT AVG(order_count) as avg_count FROM side_counts) SELECT SUM(sc.order_count) as total_count, AVG(sc.order_count - ac.avg_count) as avg_excess FROM side_counts sc CROSS JOIN avg_calc ac WHERE sc.order_count > ac.avg_count
